title: Canon alla Ottava

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the upper voice alone, in running sixteenths.
☞ Comes: the lower voice, the same line an octave lower, four bars later.
☞ The upper voice's last bars are free; the lower voice answers to the end.

listenFor: canon at the octave, four bars apart, in 9/16; the repeat is not played
